h:
该工作流程针对 4 位量化模型进行了优化，使用双节棍节点。如果您愿意，您可以轻松地将常规 UNET 或 AIO 模型与您习惯的标准节点结合使用。

以下是获得最佳结果的一些提示：

  • 还原设置：请随意尝试终极版设置以找到最适合您的图像的设置。

  • 涡轮洛拉：的涡轮洛拉包含在内是为了更快地生成，但它完全是可选的。如果您想要图像中包含更多细节，只需绕过此 LoRA 并增加采样步骤即可。

  • 添加 LoRA：要添加您自己的 LoRA，只需将它们加载到LoRA加载器并记住将其特定的触发词包含在LoRA 触发词文本区域。

  • 自定义潜在尺寸：的图像尺寸节点是一个有用的起点，但您拥有完全的控制权！您可以禁用它并直接调整潜在尺寸以获得您需要的确切尺寸。

o.en:
This workflow is optimized for a 4-bit quantized model using theNunchaku Node. If you prefer, you can easily use a regular UNET or AIO model with the standard nodes you're used to.

Here are a few tips to get the best results:

  • Redux Settings:Feel free to experiment with theReduxsettings to find what works best for your image.

  • Turbo LoRA:TheTurbo LoRAis included for faster generation, but it's completely optional. If you want more detail in your image, just bypass this LoRA and increase your sampling steps.

  • Adding LoRAs:To add your own LoRAs, simply load them into theLoRA Loaderand remember to include their specific trigger words in theLoRA Trigger Wordtext area.

  • Custom Latent Size:TheImage Sizenode is a helpful starting point, but you have full control! You can disable it and adjust the latent size directly to get the exact dimensions you need.
